label: PF Backlog 414
title: Precheck tiers: fast per-phase default vs --full (validation/lifecycle + full suite)
body: Extends BI-PF-0382. Default precheck now runs a FAST tier (core gates + gates for the touched AREA + scoped tests; ~33s) instead of ~296s. Heavy validation/lifecycle gates (validation-engine, feature-pr, merge-gate, dogfood, release, final-audit, backlog-e2e) + full suite run only with --full (merge/CI). Per-gate timings printed; slowest-5 summarised.
